candidate.bug_signature: entry point names containing path traversals escape the scripts directory during wheel installation
candidate.repro_summary: Creating a wheel with an entry point name like '../escaped' will install the script outside the intended scripts directory.
candidate.bad_behavior: pip generates the script outside the bin/scripts directory, potentially overwriting system files.
candidate.expected_behavior: pip should reject the installation with an error if the entry point name attempts path traversal.
candidate.preserved_behavior: Normal entry points should still be installed correctly in the scripts directory.
